parsedVerdict.reasoning: The unit passes. All five files have one job: they define the input types for the analytics read-side queries used by the AnalyticsQueryService port and the use cases. AnalyticsPeriodQuery is the shared from/to time window. TopProductsQuery and PaymentsTimeSeriesQuery extend it instead of redeclaring the fields. PaymentsTimeSeriesQuery uses the module's AnalyticsBucket from analytics.policy rather than defining its own bucket type. InventoryAlertsQuery has no time window, which fits an alerts query. None of the files hold business rules or invariants; the overview file's comment says the previous window is computed by the use case, so that logic lives in one place outside the unit. One small inconsistency: AnalyticsOverviewQuery declares from/to again instead of extending AnalyticsPeriodQuery. Because TypeScript compares types by shape, it still matches AnalyticsPeriodQuery, and the copy is two field declarations, not a rule. It is worth tidying but is not a real bypass of the module's abstraction or a split into unrelated concerns.
